summary.text: Nancy J. King, a Democrat, represents District 39 (Montgomery County) in the Maryland Senate and is listed on the Budget and Taxation, Executive Nominations and Rules committees.

paragraphs.text: King was born in Niagara Falls, New York, on October 7, 1949, and graduated from LaSalle High School there.
The legislature's biography lists study at Niagara County Community College from 1967 to 1969.

It lists King as vice president and chief financial officer of Trecor, Inc., a family-owned consulting and forensic engineering company, since 1987, and says King is married with three daughters and two grandchildren.
